title: Cache Management
subtitle: Clear cache to refresh application data
clearAllDesc: Clear all application cache (settings, categories, permissions)
settingsCacheDesc: CMS configuration cache. Auto-expires after 2 minutes.
categoryCacheDesc: Category tree cache. Auto-expires after 1 minute.
permissionsCacheDesc: Roles & permissions cache. Auto-expires after 5 minutes.
rateLimitCacheDesc: IP-based request throttling state. Clear when testing or if an IP is incorrectly blocked.
confirmClearRateLimit: Clear all rate limit state? Blocked IPs will be unblocked.
confirmSettingsMsg: Clear "Settings" cache? CMS configuration will be reloaded from DB.
confirmCategoryMsg: Clear "Category" cache? Category tree will be reloaded from DB.
confirmPermissionsMsg: Clear "Permissions" cache? Permissions will be re-checked from DB.
confirmRateLimitMsg: Clear all rate limit state? Blocked IPs will be unblocked immediately.
clearAllWarning: ⚠️ Rate limit state will NOT be cleared by this action.
footerHint: 💡 Clear cache after changing configuration to ensure data displays correctly. "Clear all" only clears application cache — rate limit state must be cleared separately.
